jobs.title: People Operations & Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  
  
We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  
  
Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

As we scale, we need someone who can keep both our hiring engine and our employee experience running smoothly. This is a hybrid role: roughly half recruiting coordination and half People Operations. You will own interview logistics and the candidate experience on one side, and onboarding, benefits coordination, and core HR administration on the other.

You will be the connective tissue between candidates, new hires, and the teams they join. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and the People team, and you will keep finding ways to make our processes faster and better using AI tools. This is an ideal first or second step into a generalist People career for someone who wants real ownership and exposure to both talent and people operations at a fast-growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Recruiting Coordination (~50%)**

* Own interview scheduling and logistics across multiple concurrent searches, spanning technical and non-technical roles
* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, communicating with a warm, informative tone that makes every touchpoint feel considered
* Coordinate availability across candidates, interviewers, hiring managers, and leadership, including onsite and virtual interviews, panel prep, and debrief scheduling
* Proactively flag scheduling conflicts and pipeline bottlenecks before they become delays
* Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline hygiene in Ashby
* Support offer logistics and hand off new hires to People Ops

**People Operations (~50%)**

* Own end-to-end onboarding for new hires, including pre-employment background checks, new hire paperwork, I-9 verification, travel arrangements, and any other pre-boarding coordination
* Coordinate benefits administration, including new hire enrollment, answering employee benefits questions, and working with brokers and vendors
* Support core HR operations such as maintaining employee records and HRIS data accuracy
* Help prepare employment documentation, such as employment verifications, and status changes, etc in partnership with the People team
* Support employee lifecycle processes including role changes, leaves, and offboarding logistics
* Provide support and contribute to People programs and events such as team onsites, engagement efforts, and new hire welcomes

**Across Both Areas**

* Identify opportunities to use AI tools to streamline scheduling, communication, onboarding, and reporting, and help build and implement those improvements
* Suggest and drive improvements to our recruiting and People processes, especially in ambiguous or undefined situations
* Handle confidential candidate and employee information with care and good judgment

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Experience in Recruiting or People Ops:** 1 - 3 years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator, People Operations Coordinator, HR Coordinator, or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or tech company. Strong internship experience combined with exceptional ownership will also be considered
* **Organized and Detail-Oriented:** Manage many moving pieces, from interview loops to new hire checklists, without dropping details
* **Candidate and Employee-First Mentality:** Treat every interaction, whether with a candidate or a brand-new hire, as a chance to make someone feel supported
* **Strong Written and Verbal Communication:** Write clear, friendly emails that build rapport and keep every stakeholder informed
* **Trustworthy with Sensitive Information:** Understand the importance of confidentiality and use sound judgment when handling personal and employment data
* **AI-Native Working Style:** Use AI tools regularly to streamline your work, and you are excited to find new ways to apply them
* **Bias Towards Process Improvement:** Notice where a workflow is inefficient and take the initiative to fix it, rather than just working around it
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Work across two functions and many stakeholders at once, even when the process isn’t fully defined yet
* **Nice to have:** Experience with Ashby or a similar ATS, and Rippling or a similar HRIS and benefits platforms, and exposure to US employment basics (onboarding compliance, benefits enrollment cycles)

**What We Offer**
=================

* The base salary range for this role is $80,000-$100,000, depending on experience and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
* Flexible time off
* Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources
* Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well-being, and fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot
* Complimentary in-office

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At Arkenstone Defense, we empower defense tech startups with the tools, infrastructure, and compliance solutions they need to become successful prime contractors. Our mission is to remove barriers and help innovators grow - from day one to becoming a trusted prime for the U.S. Government.

We're early, we're lean, and we're building something that actually matters. The people who do well here aren't waiting to be told what to do; they see a gap and fill it.

### **Overview**

As **Executive Assistant to the CEO**, you are the best steward of CEO’s time for the company. You keep his highest-leverage work moving: the strategic calendar, the sales follow-up email that keeps deals alive, the investor communications, and the conferences where he meets the people who fill the funnel.

You report to the Director of Revenue Operations & Growth, who coaches you and holds you accountable for CEO’s top-of-funnel work. Your core mandate is to make sure the CEO's time goes to the work only he can do, and that every follow-up, lead, and commitment gets an owner, a date, a known blocker, and a check-in until it closes out. You handle investor, board, and personnel matters with complete discretion.

### **What You’ll Do**

**Strategic Calendar and Time**

* Be the best steward of CEO’s time for the company. Protect blocks for the work only he can do.
* Fill the strategic calendar deliberately. Roughly half of it goes underused today, and closing that gap is a priority.
* Manage direct calendar time: the meetings the CEO takes personally. Each one gets prep, an agenda, and a follow-up.
* Keep an action-item and decision log for every meeting the CEO attends: owner, due date, blockers, next check-in. Chase updates before the next meeting, not after.

**Email and Sales Follow-Up**

* Own sales follow-up email on CEO’s behalf. Work proactively: draft follow-ups before threads go cold, not after the CEO asks.
* Triage CEO’s inbox so he sees what needs him, and the team handles the rest.

**Top of Funnel**

* Own the logistics for CEO’s founder-network and prospect meetings that create opportunities.
* Track every intro and meeting in Salesforce to an opportunity or a documented close-out.
* Report weekly to the Director on CEO’s top-of-funnel output against the Founder Network target of 10 opportunities per week, shared across CEO and COO.

**Investor Relations Logistics**

* Align with the CEO and marketing on what goes out to investors and how often.
* Postcards go out bi-monthly. Marketing owns the content. The EA owns the logistics.
* Maintain the investor tracker, including swag sends.
* Prepare for and attend investor meetings with the CEO. Take notes and drive follow-up to close.
* Support the capital raise with the CEO and Finance: keep the investor pipeline current, manage the data room, and track diligence requests.
* Help prepare board materials and coordinate board meeting logistics with the CEO and Finance.

**Conferences, Events, and Offsites**

* Attend conferences with the CEO. Capture every lead and own the follow-up on each one.
* Handle registrations, travel, agendas, and attendee lists for conferences, customer events, and company offsites.

**Special Projects**

* Support CEO priority projects that span teams: track owners, dates, and blockers, and keep work moving to close.
* Help stand up new initiatives and hand them off cleanly once a permanent owner is in place.

**Discretion**

* Handle board, investor, legal, HR, and personnel matters with complete confidentiality. Share only what the recipient needs to act.

### 

### **Requirements**

* Experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in a fast moving company.
* Strong writing skills, including drafting email on an executive’s behalf.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a similar CRM.
* Experience coordinating conferences, events, and travel.
* Able to work onsite in Menlo Park four days a week and travel to conferences.

  

### **Who You Are**

**Injects discipline:** Every open item gets a when, a known blocker, and a check-in date. CEO wants progress, so bring him the status before he has to ask.

**High EQ:** Reads the room, earns trust with executives and individual contributors, and stays steady when things get uncomfortable.

**Curious:** Learns the business fast.

**Fast:** Moves on requests, drafts, and decisions the same day. Speed is the default.

**Bias toward action:** Turns a request into a finished task without waiting for a second reminder.

**Proactive:** Spots the problem before it lands and brings a fix with it.

**Prioritization:** Knows what gets done today, what waits, and what goes back to the Director with a recommendation.

  

### **Mission Alignment**

We are a Defense-focused company supporting sensitive and cleared workforces. The **Executive Assistant to the CEO** will embrace our commitment to operational excellence, compliance rigor, and a world-class employee experience.

  

### **Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Requires travel to conferences, customer events, and company offsites with the CEO.
* Ability to communicate effectively in written and verbal form.

**Benefits of working with us!**

We are committed to supporting our employees both professionally and personally. Our robust benefits package is designed to promote your well-being, growth, and work-life balance

* **Competitive Salary:** Recognizing your hard work with attractive compensation and rewarding excellence.

* **Retirement Planning:** Secure your future with our flexible 401(k) plan and matching company contributions.

jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** HBCI Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** HBCI Program Supervisor

**DEPARTMENT**: HBCI (Home Based Crisis Intervention Program)

**JOB TYPE:** Part Time, 21 hours per week

**OBJECTIVES:** Reporting to the HBCI Program Supervisor, the part-time HBCI Coordinator supports the delivery of high-quality, family-centered, home-based crisis intervention services for youth and families by providing clinical supervision, staff support, program oversight, and regulatory compliance monitoring. The HBCI Program Coordinator collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery, adherence to OMH and agency standards, and the achievement of program goals and outcomes while promoting best practices in behavioral health care.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Works closely with the HBCI Program Supervisor to ensure all HBCI program requirements are met.

* Collaborate with the HBCI Program Supervisor in the development and implementation of program goals, objectives, and strategies.

* Supervises Interventionists who provide on-site and crisis-based intervention services to high-risk youth and their families.

* Accompany HBCI staff on initial home visits and provide coverage for visits when staff are unavailable or out of the office.

* Monitors the productivity and performance of HBCI Interventionists to ensure delivery of high-quality services.

* Reviews staff documentation in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to ensure timely, accurate, and complete recordkeeping.

* Ensures compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, including those established by OMH and DOHMH.

* Provides 24-hour on-call coverage for the HBCI program, as assigned.

* Collaborates with the Director of Behavioral Health/Clinic, Assistant Directors, Program Coordinators, Intake Department, and Quality Assurance team to deliver best-practice clinical services in compliance with OMH regulations.

* Attends agency, community, and external meetings and events as required.

* Performs other duties as assigned by the HBCI Program Supervisor and/or the Director of Behavioral Health.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS**:

* Knowledge and experience utilizing evidence-based treatment models and interventions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships.
* Ability to present program services and information to community organizations and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated cultural competence, humility, and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* LMSW/ LCSW or LMHC with a current New York State License.
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with children, adolescents, or young adults experiencing acute mental health crises.
* Experience providing services to youth and families impacted by behavioral health challenges.
* Experience delivering home-based services and willingness to travel to clients’ homes.
* Experience providing clinical supervision to staff, SIFI training preferred.
* Bilingual Spanish-speaking skills preferred.

**COMPENSATION: $35 per hour, 21 hours per week**

**About Northside**

Northside Center for Child Development serves more than 5,500 children and families across New York City each year through high-quality, outcome-driven behavioral health, early childhood education, and enrichment services. With over $34 million in annual funding, Northside provides the comprehensive support children and families need to overcome adversity, build resilience, and pursue their dreams.

Founded in 1946 in Harlem, Northside has been a cornerstone of the community for eight decades, leading the way in integrating education and mental health to support children’s development. Several of Northside’s innovative programs were the first of their kind in Harlem, setting standards of care that continue to influence social service agencies throughout the United States today.

Northside’s founders, Drs. Kenneth B. and Mamie Phipps Clark, were renowned, pioneering psychologists whose groundbreaking research was instrumental in the 1954 Brown v. Board of Education landmark Supreme Court decision that declared school segregation unconstitutional. Their belief in the worth, dignity, and potential of every child continues to guide Northside’s mission and inspire its work today. Northside is driven by its vision and principle, “Each Child…First Chance.”

For more information on Northside Center for Child Development, please visit www.northsidecenter.org.

jobs.description:
**Organizational Background**

City Living NY (CLNY) empowers youth aging out of foster care across New York City to transition successfully by providing essential resources and in-depth support. Initially, we identify the home goods and furnishings they need to turn their first apartments into homes, and maintain contact with them for two years to ensure housing stability. These youth are also eligible for our more intensive Core Program where they work with their assigned social worker to identify their goals and receive support around a wide range of issues including educational, employment, financial, social-emotional, and parenting. We stay with our clients through these critical first years and provide the stability and resources so many do not have. When foster care ends, our work begins.

**About the Position:** Reporting to the Alumni Program Supervisor, the Alumni Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of the Alumni Program. The Alumni Program Coordinator will collaborate with the Alumni Program Supervisor to innovate on existing programming, and lead development on new offerings. With guidance from their supervisor, the Alumni Program Coordinator will also partner directly with alumni to provide support in areas like housing, employment, education and crisis management.

**Responsibilities**

*Case Management (70% of time)*

* Provide ongoing case management, supportive counseling, and crisis intervention services to alumni participants.
* Assist alumni in accessing housing, employment, education, healthcare, and mental health resources.
* Perform home and community visits, as needed.
* Provide referrals to appropriate agencies/ organizations and accompany clients to appointments as needed.
* Maintain case records and documentation in accordance with agency standards.

*Program Operations (30% of time)*

* Co-plan and execute alumni workshops and the annual Alumni Community Event.
* Coordinate emergency grant initiatives, including the Rent Matching Program.
* Gather feedback from the Alumni Advisory Board and coordinate the implementation of recommendations to enhance program offerings and alumni engagement.
* Participate in weekly team meetings and collaboration efforts.
* Represent the alumni program at agency, community, and partner meetings.
* Track program outcomes and prepare reports as requested by the Executive Director.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by Alumni Program Supervisor, Program Director and Executive Director.

**Qualifications**

*Experience*

* Bachelor's degree required; Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) preferred.
* Minimum of one year working with at-risk teens and young adults and/or in child welfare (or equivalent experience preferred).
* Experience navigating complex social service, educational, and other systems, particularly those serving young adults in NYC.
* Experience in coaching and empowering individuals.

*Skills and Interests*

* A self-starter and creative problem solver who takes initiative and demonstrates flexibility in response to continually changing situations
* Ability to work independently, with excellent organizational skills and maintain detailed and up-to-date records
* Ability to flex hours and conduct home visits/phone contacts on evenings and/or weekends as needed to accommodate client schedules
* Candidates with lived experience in foster care, housing instability, or related systems are strongly encouraged to apply
* A genuine interest in CLNY’s mission of supporting young adults aging out of the foster care system transition successfully into adulthood
* Bilingual Spanish/English a plus

Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

We've already landed in some of the most influential organizations on the planet from nimble startups to Fortune 100 giants. Over 400+ customers trust us to power their contract workflows, and our AI Contract Repository and Intelligence products are becoming mission-critical for legal and procurement teams at scale.

As we scale, we need commercially sharp Account Managers who can run a high-velocity book of business, protecting and growing revenue without losing quality or pace. As a Mid-Market Account Manager, you'll be responsible for renewals, upsells, and expansion. You'll move fast, know where to spend your time based on health signals, renewal timing, and upsell potential, and run repeatable commercial motions that compound over time. This is a quota-carrying role with direct impact on Ivo's revenue from day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Own Your Book**
-----------------

* Develop strong stakeholder management strategies by identifying, mapping and cultivating relationships across multiple functions and levels within customer accounts to mitigate risk, increase stickiness, and uncover growth opportunities.
* Run tight, proactive renewal cycles - starting conversations early, identifying risk before it becomes churn, and closing on time.
* Prioritize your book based on health signals, renewal timing, and upsell potential — and drive the right conversations.

**Grow Revenue**
----------------

* Identify and close upsell and expansion opportunities across your accounts including new products and expanded use cases.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline hygiene in CRM in partnership with your manager, leadership and RevOps.

**Partner Cross-Functionally**
------------------------------

* Work closely with Customer Success Managers, Solutions Engineers, Legal Engineers and Implementation leads to ensure seamless coordination between value delivery and commercial strategy.
* Facilitate case studies, reference programs, and marketing initiatives helping Ivo win new business.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* **3+ years** of account management or sales experience in B2B SaaS, with a consistent track record in quota-carrying roles.
* **Proven track record** of managing and growing large book of accounts simultaneously and know how to triage, prioritize, and run repeatable motions at pace.
* **Account planning and multi-threading** — you can assess your book, identify whitespace, map key contacts across teams, and orchestrate deals with multiple stakeholders.
* **Strong commercial acumen** comfortable navigating large contracts, pricing conversations and procurement processes.
* **Collaborative operator** you know how to align internal teams (CS, Product, Legal, Finance) around customer needs and high-stakes renewals.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience in legal tech, contract management, or vertical SaaS
* Familiarity with AI/ML products and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.
* Experience with complex deals involving legal, finance, and IT buying centers.

**Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:**
-------------------------------------------

* Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.
* You have a strong internal sense of urgency. You have a bias towards doing things *today*, rather than tomorrow.
* Experience working in a startup environment is preferred but not required.
* Are excited about the adventure of building a company!

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.
* **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast
* **Health & Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.
* **Flexible Spending & Insurance:** Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.
* **401(k) Program:** Save for the future with our 401(k) program.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.
* **Unlimited PTO:** So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.

**FAQ**

* *What stage of growth is Ivo at?:* We recently raised our Series B after growing 6x in 12 months.
* *Is this a chill gig?:* Startups are very hard, especially if they’re growing fast. You’ll have a ton of responsibility, and there’s always an enormous amount of stuff to do. It’s hard work but the payoff is uncapped.

*Ivo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences - restaurants, events, wellness and travel - and the million-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time.

**Social Media Specialist — NA**

***Full-time · Chicago (preferred) or US remote · Reports to Brand Marketing Director***

**About the Role**
==================

We're looking for a Social Media Manager to lead organic social strategy for Groupon across our main market, North America. This is a hands-on, AI-driven role: you'll set the direction, but you'll also be in the platforms every day — building, testing, and producing with generative tools as your default.

You'll report to the Brand Marketing Director, and you'll work closely with the Social Media Manager for International on shared standards, tooling, and production, and partner with our new Creative Director on creative quality and campaign integration. The remit is organic only across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and whichever platform matters next quarter.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Strategy & direction**

* Lead the organic social strategy across North America (US) — channel mix, content pillars, posting cadence, and platform-specific approaches.
* Define what *good* looks like for our channels and translate brand strategy into social-native ideas that actually perform on each platform.
* Set quarterly priorities and a content roadmap aligned with brand campaigns, commercial moments, and platform trends.

### **Hands-on production**

* Personally produce flagship content and AI-driven experiments — you should be in the tools, not just briefing them.
* Build with generative tools (e.g. Kling, Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Runway, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) and adopt new ones as they emerge. Specific tools matter less than fluency and taste.
* Maintain a consistent weekly publishing cadence across priority channels to keep our communities active and our accounts present in the algorithm, using AI-driven production to make that volume possible without dropping the bar on quality.
* Prototype new formats and content concepts that the rest of the team can then scale into a repeatable production line.

### **Collaboration**

* Partner with the Social Media Manager for INTL on shared creative standards, AI tooling, production workflows, and the use of shared resources across the function.
* Work closely with the Creative Director on visual identity, campaign integration, and creative quality.
* Coordinate with regional market leads, PR, performance marketing, and brand to keep social aligned with the wider company narrative.

### **Performance & insight**

* Own the metrics that matter for organic social — views, reach, engagement quality, audience growth, brand-relevant signals — and translate them into clear decisions.
* Run a regular test-and-learn cadence; kill what underperforms quickly; double down on what works.
* Build monthly readouts that move the conversation beyond vanity metrics.

**Key Requirements**
====================

* Portfolio required. Please submit a link or PDF with your application showing examples of social content you have personally produced, including AI-generated work. A brief document, a portfolio site, or a curated set of live post links all work — candidates without a portfolio won't be assessed.
* 2–4 years in social media, with at least one year of strategic ownership of a brand channel (not purely scheduling/community).
* Deep cultural fluency with how Gen Z audiences consume and create on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — formats, humor, aesthetic codes, and the cadence at which trends rise and burn out.
* Demonstrable portfolio of AI-generated social content. We will look at the actual work — examples might include AI video (Kling, Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Runway), AI imagery (Midjourney, Flux), AI audio/voice (ElevenLabs), or hybrid workflows.
* Native or proficient English.
* Deep platform fluency on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — formats, algorithm behaviour, and what audiences in INTL markets actually respond to.
* Comfort with data: you can read a content performance report and tell the team what to do next.
* Hands-on experience pulling, interpreting, and acting on social data — using either platform-native analytics (TikTok Studio, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio) or third-party tools (Sprout, Dash Hudson, Brandwatch, or similar).
* Self-directed. You can take an ambiguous brief and come back with a plan, not more questions.
* Experience running social for a brand operating across multiple European markets.

**Nice to Have**
================

* **C**omfortable being on camera. A meaningful share of our content works best when filmed first-person — trying a deal, walking through an experience, reacting in real time — and willingness to record yourself for that kind of content is a plus.
* Experience leading or mentoring others, even informally.
* Experience working across multiple markets or time zones.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in New York City, NY)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data

jobs.title: Specialist, Business Development Representative - C_MAT
jobs.description:
Would you like to flex your "sales muscles" in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Are you ready to challenge yourself by working with some of the top sales executives at Deloitte? We are seeking candidates for our Business Development Representative (BDR) position, part of the Ecosystems & Alliances portfolio, that will interface with some of the largest, and most sophisticated companies in the industry - our Alliance partners! This is a unique opportunity. It might be the right fit for you if:
  

* You understand that you choose your attitude each day and look for the best in people and situations
* You manage the heck out of any project. Period.
* You pay attention to details. You dot your i's and cross your t's.
* You thrive in fast-paced environments. Your competitive spirit and passion for winning is off the charts. You hate to lose (while remaining a good sport).

  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
The Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with the Channel Sales Management (CSM) and Sales Executive teams assigned to an alliance and will be at the front lines of the sales process. The BDR will perform a wide variety of activities focused on managing incoming sales leads, qualifying them, and providing handoff and support to the appropriate sales team as needed throughout the sales process. The Business Development Representative will develop deep knowledge of their alliance(s), the Deloitte CSM team and alliance's sales team, and develop strong relationships with the appropriate Deloitte offering team. The role involves:
  

* Establishing contact with identified leads through multiple channels and monitoring progress
* Qualifying leads and sharing relevant marketing and/or eminence materials to develop the lead
* Providing a strong lead and hand-off to the Sales Executive team
* Partnering with the CSM to develop sales opportunities for the Sales Executives & Service Line
* Building strong cross-functional relationships with all members of the alliance team
* Staying current with alliance news, trends and hot topics
* Supporting CSM team in monitoring and sharing relevant thought leadership, client & marketplace news, and alliance materials
* Proposing ideas for alliance team to connect with clients, including customization of Deloitte eminence materials and distribution of relevant thought-leadership to key stakeholders

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Unparalleled communication skills - you can talk to anyone about anything, especially over the phone
* You're an excellent writer. You speak clearly and with persuasion
* You're self-motivated to knock it out of the park every single time, regardless who's watching
* Exceptional relationship building/relationship management skills to establish rapport, trust and confidence with alliance teams, sales teams, and clients
* Detail oriented, ability to adapt to changing environment
* Energetic, enthusiastic and organized
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management
Ability to work autonomously while being a team player  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
The Sales Center of Excellence (COE) supports Deloitte's businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working hand-in-hand with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, these sales executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 3 years' experience
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900-$147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Arborist Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Urban Arborists BTH LLC is a knowledge driven, leading private tree-care company based in Red Hook, Brooklyn, serving the five boroughs of New York City and the surrounding tristate area. Urban Arborists is widely known for the accuracy of its recommendations and the quality of its work. We also love to plant new trees. Over the past three decades, we have planted more than 7,000 trees. We also serve hundreds of private clients annually, from those with humble urban backyards or container gardens to luxury condo terraces.

We are looking for a motivated Arborist Sales Representative to join our team. This role combines tree care expertise with customer relationship management, helping residential and commercial clients identify their tree care needs and providing customized solutions. The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills, arboricultural knowledge, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service.

**Urban Arborists BTH LLC is seeking an ambitious, results-driven Arborist Sales Representative to help grow our business throughout New York City and the surrounding Tri-State area.**

We are looking for someone who brings together two essential qualities: **strong sales instincts and a solid understanding of trees, plants, and their care.** The ideal candidate is confident, personable, motivated by results, and excited to develop new business while delivering exceptional service to existing clients.

This is a **client-facing, sales-focused position** for someone who enjoys being in the field, developing relationships, and driving revenue.

You will be responsible for generating new business, managing client relationships, assessing properties, and recommending customized tree and plant care solutions.

Success in this role requires more than technical knowledge. We want a proactive sales professional who can recognize opportunities, communicate value, confidently present proposals, and close business.

**Key Responsibilities -** Sales & Business Development

* Actively pursue new business opportunities with residential and commercial clients.
* Build relationships with property managers, homeowners, landscape professionals, building managers, and other potential referral sources.
* Convert incoming leads into sales through timely follow-up, compelling proposals, and strong closing skills.
* Identify opportunities to expand services within existing accounts.
* Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals.
* Represent Urban Arborists professionally while building lasting client relationships.

**Tree Care & Horticultural Expertise**

* Conduct on-site property visits to assess trees, shrubs, and overall plant health.
* Identify common tree species, plant health concerns, and maintenance needs.
* Recommend appropriate services, including pruning, removals, tree planting, plant health care, and ongoing maintenance.
* Educate clients on the value of proactive tree and plant care.
* Translate technical recommendations into clear, persuasive proposals that clients understand and appreciate.

**Client & Project Management**

* Prepare detailed estimates, proposals, and service recommendations.
* Maintain consistent communication with prospects and existing clients.
* Collaborate with operations teams to ensure a seamless transition from sale to project execution.
* Maintain accurate client records, sales activity, and follow-up schedules.
* Deliver a high level of responsiveness, professionalism, and customer service.

What We're Looking For

**The ideal candidate is a salesperson first, with meaningful experience in horticulture, arboriculture, or plant care.**

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven sales ability with a strong desire to generate new business and exceed goals.
* Professional experience or practical knowledge in tree care, horticulture, landscaping, plant health care, or a related green industry.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Confidence presenting recommendations, negotiating proposals, and closing sales.
* Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable managing an independent sales pipeline.
* Ability to identify common trees and plants and recognize basic plant health concerns.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to client properties throughout the service area.
* Comfortable working outdoors and conducting property visits in varying weather conditions.

**Highly Desirable**

* Previous sales experience in arboriculture, landscape services, horticulture, or another service-based industry.
* ISA Certified Arborist designation or willingness to pursue certification.
* Existing relationships with property managers, landscape architects, building managers, or residential clients.
* Experience developing estimates, managing accounts, and meeting revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of tree biology, pruning practices, and plant health care.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive base salary
* Health and dental insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company vehicle or mileage reimbursement, if applicable
* Professional development and certification assistance
* Opportunity for career growth within an established and respected company

Position Information

**Recruitment/Posting Title**

Clinical Research Coordinator I

  

**Job Category**

**Department**

Public Health

  

**Overview**

New Jersey’s academic health center, Rutgers Biomedical and Health Sciences (RBHS) takes an integrated approach to educating students, providing clinical care, and conducting research, all with the goal of improving human health. Aligned with Rutgers University–New Brunswick and collaborating universitywide, RBHS includes eight schools, a behavioral health network, and five centers and institutes that focus on cancer treatment and research, neuroscience, advanced biotechnology and medicine, environmental and occupational health, and health care policy and aging research.

Our faculty are teachers, clinicians, and scientists with unparalleled experience who advance medical innovation and provide patient care informed by the latest research findings. We offer an outstanding education in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, public health, nursing, biomedical research, and the full spectrum of allied health careers.

Our clinical and academic facilities are located throughout the state—at Rutgers University–New Brunswick, including Piscataway; and at locations in Newark, Scotch Plains, Somerset, Stratford, and other locations. Clinical partners include Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital in New Brunswick, Newark’s University Hospital in Newark, and other affiliates.

Through this community of healers, scientists, and scholars, Rutgers is equipped as never before to transform lives.

  

**Posting Summary**

Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator I within the Department of Pediatric Dentistry and Community Health at the Rutgers School of Dental Medicine (RSDM).
  
  
Under the direction of the Principal Investigator, the Clinical Research Coordinator will support the execution and management of clinical research studies, including coordinating study activities from start-up through close-out, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, maintaining data integrity, and supporting high-quality research outcomes. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. By protecting executive time, anticipating needs, organizing competing priorities, and driving follow-through, this role creates the leverage needed to focus on the highest-value work. A central part of the role is making day-to-day executive work easier by knowing what is needed before it is requested, removing friction, and creating a smooth, well-organized experience around the work.

The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and communication skills. They are comfortable operating with limited direction, quickly distinguish what is urgent from what is important, and represent executive leadership and AHEAD with professionalism and polish in every interaction.

### **Role & Responsibilities:**

**Executive partnership and prioritization**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner and primary point of contact for executive leadership, internal leaders, employees, clients, partners, and other external stakeholders.
* Develop a strong understanding of each executive’s priorities, working style, relationships, and decision-making preferences.
* Anticipate needs, identify risks, and recommend solutions before issues become urgent.
* Triage competing requests by determining what requires two or more executives’ attention, what can be delegated, and what should be deferred.
* Maintain visibility into open commitments, decisions, and follow-up items, and drive accountability through completion.

**Calendar and meeting leadership**

* Own the complex and dynamic calendars of multiple executives, balancing strategic priorities, internal operating rhythms, client and partner commitments, travel, and personal focus time.
* Protect executive time by resolving conflicts, managing tradeoffs, and ensuring that meetings have a clear purpose and the right participants.
* Prepare the relevant executive for meetings by gathering background information, briefing materials, agendas, talking points, and relevant decisions or action items.
* Capture and distribute action items as appropriate, ensuring that decisions and next steps are documented and advanced.

**Communications and information flow**

* Communicate on behalf of the executive in a tone that is clear, thoughtful, responsive, and aligned with AHEAD’s standards.
* Monitor executive inboxes and incoming requests with sound judgment, confidentiality, and an understanding of organizational context.
* When required to draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, meeting materials, and other communications in the appropriate executive’s voice.
* Provide timely updates on emerging issues, organizational developments, upcoming commitments, and decisions requiring attention.

**Travel, expenses, and logistics**

* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including air, hotel, ground transportation, itineraries, changes, and travel-related materials.
* Manage expense reporting and related approvals accurately and on time.
* Own end-to-end logistics for executive meetings, offsites, and events, including:

* + Room selection, setup, and AV or virtual platform readiness
  + Catering and refreshment orders, dietary needs, and vendor coordination
  + On-site hosting of guests, including greeting, directions, and parking or access
  + Post-meeting cleanup and room reset, stepping in personally when needed

**Special projects and executive operations**

* Create practical systems, templates, and operating rhythms that improve executive effectiveness and reduce friction.
* Partner with other Executive Assistants and cross-functional teams to coordinate coverage, improve processes, and provide consistent executive experience.
* Support preparation for senior leadership, board, advisory, and client-facing engagements as assigned.
* Handle sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

**Office Presence, Availability, and Responsiveness**

* Work in the office 4-5 days per week. An in-person presence is required when the executive(s) you support are in the office, when the office administrator needs backup coverage, as well as key meetings and events.
* Treat the role as a 24/7 executive support position, remaining available and attentive beyond standard business hours.
* Always respond promptly to time-sensitive needs.
* Anticipate what the supported executives may need before they ask.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Five or more years of experience supporting one or more C-level executives, senior executives, or equivalent leaders in a complex, fast-moving organization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume, constantly changing workload while maintaining accuracy, composure, and attention to detail.
* Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft polished executive communications.
* High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to handle confidential info

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Coordinator supports locations across the Endurant Disaster Recovery network, keeping restoration and reconstruction jobs organized, documented, and moving from estimate approval through final payment. This role manages job setup, contracts, invoicing, third-party administrator (TPA) compliance, and job status reporting under the direction of the Project Coordinator Manager, in partnership with location Estimators, Project Managers, and the VP of Construction.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple jobs, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. This person serves as a key link between corporate, field operations, estimating, customers, carriers, and trade partners, and helps bring consistent coordination practices to every location.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Job Setup and Documentation**

* Enter and maintain accurate job information, project dates, and weekly progress notes in the job management systems (RM, PSA) and corresponding TPA platforms
* Confirm jobs are approved for production and that all claim information, including the deductible, has been collected
* Collect and file required job documents, including authorizations to repair (ATRs), contracts, change orders, certificates of completion (COCs), TPA-required documents, and lien waivers
* Send work authorizations, contracts, change orders, and punch lists to customers through DocuSign, and track signatures to completion
* Request EagleView reports and other supporting documentation as needed
* Compile and file the completed supervisor estimate and supporting paperwork at job close

**Contracts, Budgeting, and Scheduling**

* Prepare contracts with clear payment schedules after estimate approval, in coordination with the Estimator
* Import estimates into PSA when needed and review work orders and job budgets against company targets
* Issue subcontracts and work orders to trade partners as directed by Project Managers, with purchase orders in place before work is released
* Build job schedules and coordinate changes with Project Managers
* Coordinate temporary assignments as needed
* Support Project Managers and Estimators in following the company change order policy, including signed change orders and collected deposits before work begins

**Invoicing and Collections**

* Match trade and supplier invoices to purchase orders and flag discrepancies
* Route invoices to Project Managers for approval and prepare customer invoices for delivery by the Estimator
* Monitor payment schedules and follow up to keep collections aligned with contract terms
* Escalate to the Project Coordinator Manager any job that starts without a collected deductible, deposit, or approved draw schedule, or whose outstanding collections exceed company thresholds

**TPA and Carrier Compliance**

* Monitor TPA platforms daily, including Contractor Connection, Westhill, and Sedgwick
* Maintain compliance with TPA guidelines, complete required uploads, and support strong performance rankings
* Upload, label, and organize job photos in TPA portals
* Follow up with adjusters on estimate approvals and supplements at the Estimator's request
* Support Estimators in communication with customers, agents, adjusters, and TPAs

**Job Tracking and Reporting**

* Attend weekly job review meetings and bi-weekly work-in-progress (WIP) meetings with the VP of Construction, Estimators, and Project Managers, and follow through on action items
* Track each job's status (Received, Scoped, Pending, Sold, WIP, Completed) and escalate jobs that stall to the Project Coordinator Manager
* Prepare and share weekly job status reports with the Project Coordinator Manager, Project Managers, and the VP of Construction
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Multi-Location Support**

* Support project coordination for locations across the Endurant network, including subsidiary companies and newly acquired locations
* Provide coverage for location coordinators during peak volume, staffing gaps, or catastrophe (CAT) events
* Promote consistent job documentation, contract, invoicing, and TPA compliance standards across locations
* Assist with onboarding new locations to company systems and coordination processes

**Performance Measures**

* TPA compliance and performance scores
* Timeliness of weekly job status updates
* Accuracy of contracts and invoices
* Turnaround time on contract and invoice creation and follow-up
* Number of delayed or on-hold jobs

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* 2+ years of experience in project coordination, construction administration, or a related office role
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple jobs and deadlines at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with customers, adjusters, and trade partners
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning job management and e-signature platforms

**Preferred**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, construction management, or a related field
* Experience in property restoration, insurance claims, or construction
* Familiarity with Xactimate, PSA, RM, DocuSign, or TPA platforms such as Contractor Connection, Westhill, or Sedgwick
* Working knowledge of invoicing, purchase orders, and collections

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
-----------------------------------------

* Hybrid work environment, with extended periods of sitting and computer use
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds
* Less than 5% travel to supporting locations and job sites as needed
* May require extended hours during high-volume periods or catastrophe (CAT) events

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. We are looking for a Production Coordinator to join our rapidly growing Manufacturing team in Atlanta, GA. In this role, you will be responsible for organizing and coordinating all aspects of production. Here you will work on cutting-edge technology aimed at advancing the state-of-the-possible. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Southeast
jobs.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Based in Cambridge, Mass., Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders. Of note, the Boston Business Journal has also voted Apnimed as one of the Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025!  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) will play a pivotal role in securing access and driving adoption of AD109 within the nation’s largest health systems and integrated delivery networks. Reporting to the National Sales Director, this senior field-based role owns a defined book of strategic accounts, engaging system-level clinical, pharmacy and administrative decision makers to establish formulary access, influence treatment protocols and pathways, and unlock the sleep and pulmonology centers within each system.  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role requiring a strategic account planner with deep experience selling into complex health systems and navigating committee-driven decision making. The KAM carries no direct reports but leads a matrixed account team, including Regional Sales Leaders and sales specialists, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing, to deliver one coordinated plan per account.  
  
**Key Job Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Own a defined portfolio of strategic health systems and integrated delivery networks, mapping the decision-making structure of each and executing an account plan spanning pre-launch preparation, launch execution and post launch growth
* Map and build relationships across all relevant stakeholders within an account, including physicians, clinical staff, pharmacy, administration, and other decision-influencers.
* Partner with Market Access to pull through national and regional payer coverage at the system level
* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account
* Identify and support system-level screening, diagnostic and care coordination initiatives that expand appropriate patient identification
* Establish account-level KPIs to measure access, adoption and pull-through, and surface system trends, access barriers and competitive intelligence to commercial leadership
* Ensure all account activity is conducted in full compliance with company policy, industry codes and applicable regulations

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical commercial experience, including 3+ years in key account management, health system or institutional selling
* Demonstrated success securing formulary access and driving protocol or pathway change within large health systems and integrated delivery networks
* Proven track record of successful product launches, ideally in specialty or CNS-related markets
* Strong working knowledge of health system economics, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy and utilization management
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
* Strong strategic account planning skills with the ability to execute tactically in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication, executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Field-based role; must reside within the assigned geography and be able to travel extensively, including overnight travel
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, or similar) preferred

**What Apnimed Offers:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Generous time off for vacation
* Generous Company paid benefits
* Flexible working environment
* Motivated and experienced team

**Location and Other Information:**

* This is a field-based role; the KAM must reside within the assigned geography.
* Apnimed is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.
* The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $220,000.
* Please visit us at www.apnimed.com to learn more about our work with Obstructive Sleep Apnea

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Veolia has acquired Clean Earth. As Clean Earth completes its integration into Veolia, recruiting and hiring for this role is being managed in partnership with the Clean Earth talent acquisition team. Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**

The Customer Experience Account Manager (CXAM) serves as a strategic commercial liaison aligned with the sales team to proactively manage customers within a designated territory. This role is pivotal in delivering Clean Earth’s best-in-class service experience, fostering long-term partnerships, and driving customer growth. The CXAM is accountable for mitigating churn, expanding share of wallet, and ensuring customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and data-driven insights.

**Primary Responsibilities** (Essential Functions):

**Customer Relationship Management** Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned territory accounts.

Engage with customer to understand their needs/preferences and ensure we deliver accordingly as an organization.

Manage account performance against territory quota and roster metrics.

Conduct regular customer business reviews and present strategic insights cross-functionally.

**Retention & Growth**

Proactively reduce churn and identify opportunities to expand service offerings. o Quote accounts using the existing price book and strategic account approach. o Answer customer questions and address concerns in an effective and timely manner.

**Operational Excellence** Monitor account health through analytics and proactive engagement. Drive lifecycle management for profiles, contracts, AR status, and onboarding of new accounts. Collaborate with CX Specialists to ensure order completeness and fulfillment.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration** Partner with regional Territory Account Managers (TAMs) to generate new profiles and communicate approval status. Escalate service issues using the customer complaint tool and ensure closed-loop resolution. Support pricing alignment, invoice accuracy, and SLA adherence.

**Reporting & Insights** Generate actionable customer and performance reports to support operational and financial goals. o Track customer satisfaction and monitor account performance. 

**Leadership & Mentorship** Mentor team members as assigned by management. o Lead team huddles and meetings as requested. Perform other related tasks as assigned.

 **Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in business, Environmental Sciences, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Minimum 3 years in customer service or account management (5 years with high school diploma). 

Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

Proficiency in CRM Microsoft Office Suite.

Willingness to travel up to 30%. Preferred Qualifications:

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as RCRA, DOT, DEA, and OSHA

Experience with SalesForce.com or familiarity with a related CRM system and practices

In addition, commencing no later than January 1, 2027, benefits package will include participation in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. Pay and benefits for employees represented by a union are outlined in their collective bargaining agreement. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law

* Team Collaboration: Willingness to work together with others, promoting teamwork and supporting shared goals

* Repeated use of sight to read documents and computer screens
* Repeated use of hearing and speech to communicate on telephone and in person

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, AJC
jobs.description:
The Strategic Account Manager will support advertising account executives through the entire lifecycle of their clients' digital sponsorship, social campaigns, native advertising and event sponsorship campaigns. Post-sale, they will serve as the client's primary contact for campaign activation. Campaign activation responsibilities include coordinating between the client and internal fulfillment teams to ensure accurate and on-time launch of all campaigns, managing the timeline from sale to campaign launch. They will monitor campaign performance, escalating any issues to the account executive and their manager and provide mid-campaign updates to client as needed. Post-sale duties will include campaign reporting and presenting findings and recommendations for future campaigns to account executive and/or client. The BDR will perform a wide variety of activities focused on managing incoming sales leads, qualifying them, and providing handoff and support to the appropriate sales team as needed throughout the sales process. The Business Development Representative will develop deep knowledge of their alliance(s), the Deloitte CSM team and alliance's sales team, and develop strong relationships with the appropriate Deloitte offering team. The role involves:
  

* Establishing contact with identified leads through multiple channels and monitoring progress
* Qualifying leads and sharing relevant marketing and/or eminence materials to develop the lead
* Providing a strong lead and hand-off to the Sales Executive team
* Partnering with the CSM to develop sales opportunities for the Sales Executives & Service Line
* Building strong cross-functional relationships with all members of the alliance team
* Staying current with alliance news, trends and hot topics
* Supporting CSM team in monitoring and sharing relevant thought leadership, client & marketplace news, and alliance materials
* Proposing ideas for alliance team to connect with clients, including customization of Deloitte eminence materials and distribution of relevant thought-leadership to key stakeholders

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Unparalleled communication skills - you can talk to anyone about anything, especially over the phone
* You're an excellent writer. You speak clearly and with persuasion
* You're self-motivated to knock it out of the park every single time, regardless who's watching
* Exceptional relationship building/relationship management skills to establish rapport, trust and confidence with alliance teams, sales teams, and clients
* Detail oriented, ability to adapt to changing environment
* Energetic, enthusiastic and organized
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management
Ability to work autonomously while being a team player  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
The Sales Center of Excellence (COE) supports Deloitte's businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working hand-in-hand with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, these sales executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 3 years' experience
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900-$147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
