jobs.title: Career Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Des Plaines, IL **Category:** Staff **Job Type:** Full Time Staff **Posted On:** Thu Oct 8 2026 **Job Description:**  
  

**Basic Function and Responsibility:**

Reporting to the Manager of the Career Development Center, the Career Development Coordinator delivers high-impact programmatic support and direct career coaching to advance student career readiness, persistence, and employment outcomes. The role provides comprehensive career guidance to credit and non-credit students, alumni, and community members, supports career/major exploration and pathway mapping, and develops job-search strategies informed by labor-market data. The Coordinator also helps design, implement, and improve career and workforce development programs and works with campus and community partners to connect students with internships, apprenticeships, and experiential learning opportunities.

**Characteristic Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide individualized and group-based career coaching to assist with major/educational pathways and career exploration, goal setting, and career pathway planning. Administer and interpret personality, major, and career assessment tools (e.g., Strong Interest Inventory) and translate into realistic, actionable career plans.
* Develop proactive outreach strategies to engage with students through one-on-one coaching sessions, classroom visits, presentations, workshops, and targeted campaigns to increase student utilization. Empower students to make well-informed, researched decisions about majors/educational pathways, careers, or internships/apprenticeships.
* Provide job search support, including resume and cover letter development, interview preparation (including mock interviews), LinkedIn optimization, and career competency development aligned with the National Association of Colleges and Employers (NACE). Offer students constructive, instructional feedback to assist with applications and enhance job readiness.
* Coordinate and facilitate career development workshops, presentations, and outreach activities for students and campus partners in multiple modalities (in-person, virtual, and hybrid).
* Collaborate with program faculty and chairs to collect and monitor job placement opportunities; support students in securing professional employment; and gather data to prepare reports on job development and placement initiatives.
* Establish and cultivate employer and industry partnerships to increase recruitment efforts and expand employment opportunities for students.
* Collaborate with Adult Continuing Education, Workforce Development (ACE-WD), Work-Based Learning, and the Small Business Development Center to organize and execute job/career fairs, including student preparation, soliciting employer participation, marketing events to the appropriate audiences, outcome tracking, and coordinating miscellaneous logistical elements.
* Collaborate with the Adult Continuing Education and Workforce Development (ACE-WD) division to teach new and continuing students how to access career exploration and non-credit-to-credit support programs and services.
* Collect, analyze, and report data related to student engagement, program participation, and employment outcomes for institutional and accreditation purposes.
* Participate in early-exposure activities aligned with the pathways-to-opportunity model, team meetings, professional development, and cross-training to enhance service delivery.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

 **Job Requirements:**

**Qualifications and Working Conditions:**

* Bachelor's degree required. An advanced degree in higher education, counseling, psychology, or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 2 years' professional experience in career services, workforce development, higher education, or human resources. Experience working with undecided college students preferred.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Career Services Provider, Global Career Development Facilitator) are a plus.
* Proficiency with career services platforms (Handshake, Symplicity, etc.) and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred): strong data collection and reporting skills.
* Strong understanding of higher education transfer/admissions processes and labor market information to align students' academic plans with employment opportunities.
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication; customer service orientation; ability to establish productive relationships with students, faculty, staff, and employers; strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills; ability to coordinate multiple initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Ability to interact respectfully and tactfully with diverse populations, maintain confidential records, and work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.

**Physical Demands:**

Mobility to move from building to building on-campus and to visit off-campus entities. Work is performed in a general office environment and is sedentary in nature?little or no exposure to adverse working conditions.

 **Additional Information:**

**HOURS: Monday - Friday 8:15 am - 5:00 pm**

The Division Marketing Coordinator supports community-level marketing operations by managing marketing requests, digital listings, collateral coordination, and local vendor activity across assigned communities. This role serves as a primary point of contact for sales team marketing needs and supports the execution of events, signage, photoshoots, virtual tours, community launches, and model home or store setup. * Ability to support event planning, community visits, signage coordination, and store readiness activities with professionalism and follow-through.

**Work Conditions:**

jobs.description:
We are seeking an **Account Coordinator** to join our Operations Team. This role serves as a primary point of contact for facility communication, account support, and customer service coordination across an assigned territory. This role requires an individual with strong communication, multitasking, and problem-solving skills who can effectively manage high-volume client interactions. If you are looking for a company focused on being the best in the industry, enjoy taking on challenges, and want to make a direct impact on our patients and providers, then look no further!

This will be a full-time, exempt position reporting to the Senior Manager of Operations.

**What you will do:**

* **Client Communication & Support:** Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound client calls, addressing questions, concerns, and service-related inquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and empathy. Manage an average inbound call volume of 100–120 calls per week.
* **Visit Confirmation & Scheduling Support:** Conduct outbound calls to confirm upcoming visits and maintain a 95% or higher confirmation rate. Manage 100–150 outbound calls weekly to support scheduling efficiency and provider productivity.
* **Email & Correspondence Management:** Respond to client and internal email inquiries in a timely, professional, and accurate manner, maintaining a standard response turnaround of 24–48 hours.
* **Referral & Documentation Coordination:** Review referrals and onboarding documentation for completeness and accuracy. Educate clients on missing information to minimize operational delays and ensure compliance with company standards. Distribute progress notes in accordance with established procedures.
* **Account Performance Management:** Monitor accounts with low patient engagement or facility penetration, identify underlying issues, and collaborate cross-functionally to implement corrective actions and long-term improvement strategies.
* **Facility Contact & Relationship Management:** Maintain accurate facility contact information and provide ongoing education and communication to support strong client relationships and adherence to company policies and procedures.
* **Issue Resolution & Escalation Management:** Manage operational disruptions, escalated client concerns, complaints, and account-related issues through timely intake, follow-up, delegation, and resolution. Escalate issues appropriately while striving for first-contact resolution whenever possible.
* **Client Feedback & Service Improvement:** Review customer satisfaction survey results to identify trends, strengthen client relationships, and support continuous service improvement initiatives.
* **Team Collaboration & Operational Support:** Participate in team meetings, communicate proactive updates, escalate recurring trends or concerns, and collaborate across departments to support operational efficiency and provider satisfaction.
* **Projects & Additional Responsibilities:** Assist with special projects, process improvement initiatives, and other departmental or organizational responsibilities as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* One or more years of relevant customer service or account management experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, multitasking, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and, at times, stressful environment.
* Ability to solve problems independently and escalate issues when necessary.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working at a computer.

**Compensation**

* The base salary for this position is $45,000 annually.
* This role is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus opportunity of up to $5,000, based on achievement of individual, departmental, and company performance objectives.
* Total compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, performance, and business needs.

jobs.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Based in Cambridge, Mass., Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders. Of note, the Boston Business Journal has also voted Apnimed as one of the Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025!  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) will play a pivotal role in securing access and driving adoption of AD109 within the nation’s largest health systems and integrated delivery networks. Reporting to the National Sales Director, this senior field-based role owns a defined book of strategic accounts, engaging system-level clinical, pharmacy and administrative decision makers to establish formulary access, influence treatment protocols and pathways, and unlock the sleep and pulmonology centers within each system.  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role requiring a strategic account planner with deep experience selling into complex health systems and navigating committee-driven decision making. The KAM carries no direct reports but leads a matrixed account team, including Regional Sales Leaders and sales specialists, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing, to deliver one coordinated plan per account.

* Own a defined portfolio of strategic health systems and integrated delivery networks, mapping the decision-making structure of each and executing an account plan spanning pre-launch preparation, launch execution and post launch growth
* Map and build relationships across all relevant stakeholders within an account, including physicians, clinical staff, pharmacy, administration, and other decision-influencers.
* Partner with Market Access to pull through national and regional payer coverage at the system level
* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account
* Identify and support system-level screening, diagnostic and care coordination initiatives that expand appropriate patient identification
* Establish account-level KPIs to measure access, adoption and pull-through, and surface system trends, access barriers and competitive intelligence to commercial leadership
* Ensure all account activity is conducted in full compliance with company policy, industry codes and applicable regulations

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical commercial experience, including 3+ years in key account management, health system or institutional selling
* Demonstrated success securing formulary access and driving protocol or pathway change within large health systems and integrated delivery networks
* Proven track record of successful product launches, ideally in specialty or CNS-related markets
* Strong working knowledge of health system economics, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy and utilization management
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
* Strong strategic account planning skills with the ability to execute tactically in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication, executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Field-based role; must reside within the assigned geography and be able to travel extensively, including overnight travel

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  
  
Marketing has not yet fully translated our tech-forward and driver-first advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events and in the materials our teams use.  
  
That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the strategic force and operational backbone for paid digital initiatives. You will execute campaigns with intention through compelling visual content and tight planning. You’ll use your expertise to run and maintain targeted campaigns to nurture leads. You’ll know where to allocate spend to maximize results, while keeping assets fresh, tailoring creative in accordance with data-backed wins. You will keep initiatives optimized, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**1. Google Ads Campaign Management & Optimization**
----------------------------------------------------

* Execute, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, and Demand Gen.
* Manage keywords, targeting, bidding, budgets, ad copy, and creative testing.
* Monitor conversions, campaign performance, cost per lead, and return on ad spend.
* Maintain accurate tracking through Google Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.
* Produce performance reports with actionable recommendations.

**2. Website Management & SEO (WordPress)**
-------------------------------------------

* Manage and update Roadrunner’s WordPress website, including pages, content, images, forms, and landing pages.
* Optimize website content for SEO, user experience, and lead generation.
* Monitor website performance, traffic, conversions, and technical issues.
* Coordinate website improvements, integrations, and troubleshooting with IT or external partners.

**3. Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Advertising**
----------------------------------------------

* Execute and optimize paid campaigns across Facebook and Instagram using Meta Ads Manager.
* Manage audience targeting, retargeting, budgets, ad creative, and A/B testing.
* Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, conversions, and cost per acquisition.
* Ensure accurate conversion tracking and reporting.

**4. Email Marketing & CRM Campaigns**
--------------------------------------

* Build, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns using HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or similar platforms.
* Manage audience segmentation, automated workflows, lead nurturing, and campaign testing.
* Collaborate with the Sales Operations Director to align campaigns with CRM data, sales pipelines, and lead follow-up processes.
* Monitor open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and campaign effectiveness.
* Maintain database quality, email deliverability, and compliance.

**5. Digital Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor digital performance across paid media, website, email, and lead generation channels.
* Build dashboards and reports using GA4, Data Studio, CRM reporting, and Excel.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, lead quality, and marketing efficiency.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Recruiting, and Operations to support business objectives.

**What you bring**
==================

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, WordPress, and CRM/email marketing, with strong analytical skills and a focus on measurable results.
* Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and campaign performance reporting.
* Experience managing monthly paid-media budgets of approximately $15,000–$25,000 and optimizing for measurable results.
* Working knowledge of WordPress, website content updates, SEO, and landing page optimization using HubSpot or other CRMs.
* Experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot including lead tracking and campaign automation.
* Google Ads certifications (such as Search or Measurement) preferred.
* Familiarity with Google Ads Editor, SEMrush, Optmyzr, or similar optimization tools is a plus.
* Desirable skills: basic HTML/CSS, SEO, landing page optimization, and marketing automation.
* The role supports digital lead generation for both customer acquisition and owner-operator recruiting, with distinct audiences, conversion funnels, and performance metrics.

**How you operate**

Would you like to flex your "sales muscles" in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Are you ready to challenge yourself by working with some of the top sales executives at Deloitte? We are seeking candidates for our Business Development Representative (BDR) position, part of the Ecosystems & Alliances portfolio, that will interface with some of the largest, and most sophisticated companies in the industry - our Alliance partners! * You understand that you choose your attitude each day and look for the best in people and situations
* You manage the heck out of any project. Period.
* You pay attention to details. You dot your i's and cross your t's.
* You thrive in fast-paced environments. Your competitive spirit and passion for winning is off the charts. You hate to lose (while remaining a good sport).

  
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
The Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with the Channel Sales Management (CSM) and Sales Executive teams assigned to an alliance and will be at the front lines of the sales process. The BDR will perform a wide variety of activities focused on managing incoming sales leads, qualifying them, and providing handoff and support to the appropriate sales team as needed throughout the sales process. The Business Development Representative will develop deep knowledge of their alliance(s), the Deloitte CSM team and alliance's sales team, and develop strong relationships with the appropriate Deloitte offering team. The role involves:
  

* Establishing contact with identified leads through multiple channels and monitoring progress
* Qualifying leads and sharing relevant marketing and/or eminence materials to develop the lead
* Providing a strong lead and hand-off to the Sales Executive team
* Partnering with the CSM to develop sales opportunities for the Sales Executives & Service Line
* Building strong cross-functional relationships with all members of the alliance team
* Staying current with alliance news, trends and hot topics
* Supporting CSM team in monitoring and sharing relevant thought leadership, client & marketplace news, and alliance materials
* Proposing ideas for alliance team to connect with clients, including customization of Deloitte eminence materials and distribution of relevant thought-leadership to key stakeholders

  
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Unparalleled communication skills - you can talk to anyone about anything, especially over the phone
* You're an excellent writer. You speak clearly and with persuasion
* You're self-motivated to knock it out of the park every single time, regardless who's watching
* Exceptional relationship building/relationship management skills to establish rapport, trust and confidence with alliance teams, sales teams, and clients
* Detail oriented, ability to adapt to changing environment
* Energetic, enthusiastic and organized
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management
Ability to work autonomously while being a team player  

  
  
**The Team**  
  
The Sales Center of Excellence (COE) supports Deloitte's businesses in uncovering, nurturing, and closing sales opportunities. Working hand-in-hand with Partners, Principals and Managing Directors, these sales executives focus their highly skilled efforts in securing relationships with qualified targets and decision makers to uncover opportunities, develop effective sales strategies, manage the pursuit process and act as a key advisor to the pursuit team throughout the sales process.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:
  

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 3 years' experience
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900-$147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: eCommerce & Digital Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

1928 Jewelry is a fashion jewelry brand with a passion for vintage-inspired design. We sell direct-to-consumer through our Shopify storefront and across major online marketplaces — including Amazon, Walmart, and others — and we're growing our presence across our marketplace, paid, email, and social channels.

**Position Summary**

We're looking for a hands-on E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist to run the day-to-day across our marketplace and digital channels. You'll be the person who keeps our product listings accurate and optimized, maintains our catalogs across Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify, builds and runs our ad campaigns, and pitches in on email, social, and customer inquiries. You'll spend your days inside seller consoles, ad dashboards, spreadsheets, and product listings, keeping a large catalog and multiple channels running smoothly.

It's a varied, fast-moving role with real ownership of our day-to-day e-commerce execution and plenty of visibility — a great fit for a detail-oriented doer who likes being hands-on across a lot of channels and seeing the direct impact of their work on the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Marketplace & Catalog (Day-to-Day)***

* Create, maintain, and optimize product listings across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and other marketplaces (Etsy, Faire, Shein, TikTok Shop, etc.) — new product setup, ongoing catalog maintenance, pricing updates, and keeping listings accurate and current.
* Work day-to-day inside Amazon Seller Central: create and maintain listings, catalog and variations, A+ content, cases, and account health.
* Maintain a large product catalog of hundreds to thousands of SKUs — writing and updating accurate, search-optimized listings (titles, descriptions, imagery, and attributes).

***Advertising & Performance***

* Build and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display) — setting up campaigns, monitoring them, and making ongoing optimizations.
* Conduct keyword research and search engine optimization (SEO) for both marketplace listings and the 1928.com website to improve rankings, visibility, and traffic.
* Track and report on performance using metrics such as ROAS (return on ad spend), ACOS (advertising cost of sales), conversion rate, click-through rate (CTR), and cost per acquisition (CPA); flag what's working and where to improve.

***Website & Email***

* Manage and maintain the 1928.com Shopify storefront — including its theme, third-party apps, plugins, and integrations — to keep the site running smoothly and performing well.
* Help keep the website ADA/accessibility compliant (alt text, heading structure, link text, and metadata).
* Build and send email marketing campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.

***Social, Content & Customer Service***

* Support social media across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging channels, and help build relationships with influencers and content creators.
* Write and maintain blog posts and other marketing content.
* Respond to website and marketplace customer service inquiries with professionalism and care.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of hands-on e-commerce experience working across online marketplaces and platforms.
* Solid, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central — comfortable creating and maintaining listings and A+ content and handling cases and account health — plus working experience with channels such as Walmart Marketplace and Shopify.
* Experience maintaining a large product catalog (hundreds to thousands of SKUs): product setup, listing optimization, and day-to-day catalog upkeep.
* Hands-on experience building and managing paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Amazon Ads.
* Comfortable with keyword research and SEO, and with reading performance metrics such as ROAS, ACOS, CTR, and conversion rate.
* Hands-on experience with Shopify, including working with third-party apps, plugins, and integrations.
* Experience with website ADA compliance — making sure site content and structure meet accessibility standards (alt text, headings, link text, and metadata).
* Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, and strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis).
* Comfortable writing content across channels — product listings, blogs, email, and social.
* Strong attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and the ability to juggle multiple channels and deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social media background with experience developing relationships with influencers and content creators (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other channels) — outreach, gifted/paid collaborations, content approval, and performance tracking.
* Experience with TikTok Shop and other emerging marketplace or social-commerce channels.
* Experience with Klaviyo or a comparable email marketing platform.
* Genuine interest in fashion jewelry, accessories, or the broader fashion industry.

**Why Join Us**

You'll do varied, hands-on work across the channels that directly drive our revenue, on a small, collaborative team where your work is visible and your contributions get noticed.

*1928 Jewelry is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator- Oakland, CA
new_jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Program Coordinator provides operational, administrative, and customer support to ensure the effective delivery of homecare services for PACE programs. This role focuses on supporting caregivers (HCPs), clients, and internal teams by managing onboarding/offboarding, compliance tracking, communication, and client relations. The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring caregivers are prepared and supported, client needs are met, and all processes remain compliant and efficient.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  
1. Assist caregivers with onboarding, orientation, credentialing, and system access.
  
2. Provide ongoing support to field staff by addressing questions, resolving issues, and ensuring they have the resources needed for successful assignments.
  
3. Maintain accurate and current records of caregiver credentials, certifications, and licensures.
  
4. Communicate updates, policy changes, and assignment details clearly and promptly.
  
5. Support HCPs with timekeeping, payroll, and schedule confirmations.
  
1. Manage HCP timekeeping issues (e.g., missed punches, errors) and review timecards for processing to ensure accuracy and time corrections in a timely manager to avoid payment errors.
  
1. Serve as a primary contact for PACE program clients, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.
  
2. Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure service satisfaction.
  
3. Conduct periodic client satisfaction checks and follow up on feedback to improve service delivery.
  
4. Ensure client-specific requirements, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and shared with caregivers.
  
5. Work with Compliance team to ensure caregiver are compliant with all regulatory, licensing, and agency standards.
  
6. Maintain and update databases, internal systems, and client portals with accurate caregiver and client information.
  
7. Support audits by ensuring complete and accurate documentation is available when needed.
  
8. Generate, prepare, and distribute reports for internal teams and client review.
  
9. Assist with creating confirmation letters, client-facing communications, and process documentation.
  
10. Act as a liaison between caregivers, clients, and internal departments to ensure alignment and issue resolution.
  
11. Communicate clearly and consistently with all stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.
  
12. Provide backup coverage for colleagues to ensure uninterrupted clients and caregiver support.
  
13. Represent Cross Country Healthcare with professionalism and integrity in all interactions.
  
14. May be required to attend offsite job fairs and community events as needed.
  
15. May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
  
16. Other duties as assigned
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
1. Minimum of one (1) year of administrative or client support experience, preferably in healthcare or staffing.
  
2. Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to handle multiple priorities.
  
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  
5. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  
6. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all situations.
  
7. Experience with VMS technology or client portals.
  
8. Bilingual skills preferred.
  
9. Strong problem-solving and relationship-building abilities.
  
**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Some college preferred.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition Assistance, and Pet Insurance. The company offers a variety of Wellness options through Burnalong, which offers a robust online platform of classes and programs as well as local gym access.
  
  
Cross Country is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) - Veteran/Disability

new_jobs.description:
***Full-time, Temporary Position***

***Position Status:*** *This is a full-time, temporary position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension or transition to a permanent position based on program needs and funding availability. Extension or transition to permanent status is not guaranteed.*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Principal Program Coordinator (Coordinator)

**Reports To**: Prevention Program Manager

**Program Description:** The Prevention Education Program is a comprehensive substance use prevention program that includes 3 core interventions: Communities Mobilizing for Change on Alcoholism (CMCA), Strengthening Families Program (SFP), Botvin LifeSkills Program (LST) and outreach activities.

**Position Description:** The Coordinator will be trained and responsible for facilitating groups for the 3 core interventions (CMCA, LST, SFP) according to the contract requirements and program needs. Key duties and responsibilities include outreach and recruitment, group facilitation, family engagement, data collection, reporting, etc. As part of the Prevention Team and work with the CMCA groups, the Coordinator will also participate in the COUN-SEL Coalition meetings and events as well as contribute broader prevention efforts as assigned.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop outreach materials and conduct outreach and recruitment for the Strengthening Families Program, with a focus on engaging African American/Black and Spanish-speaking families, as well as for Botvin LifeSkills, CMCA, and other Prevention services.
* Coordination of service provision for each intervention.
* Schedule, plan, and conduct participant orientations for admission and enrollment.
* Co-facilitate the Parent/Youth/Family components of the Strengthening Families program.
* Facilitate and lead Botvin Lifeskills program and CMCA cohorts onsite or at local school sites.
* Maintain youth files for all program participants, each cycle, as needed.
* Maintain detailed records of program attendance/services for reporting and submit monthly reports.
* Enter program services data into a tracking sheet within 24 hrs of activity.
* Reconcile data on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Attend weekly program meetings, monthly All Staff meetings, and other meetings including funding source meetings.
* Maintain a programmatic budget.
* Implement program evaluations to measure the impact of delivery of services (i.e client satisfaction surveys, pre and post tests, etc.).
* Complete mandatory state compliance and other training.
* Support agency wide efforts which includes participation in 1-2 community wide committees/collectives that support the overall program mission and organizational values.
* Other duties assigned by the Prevention Program Manager.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in social sciences or related field and/or 2+ years experience providing direct services for youth.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate youth groups.
* Commitment to learn environmental prevention work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and juggle multiple competing deadlines/tasks in a fast paced environment.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily attendance, hours tracking. monthly and quarterly reports, etc.
* Experience using Zoom, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Classroom, etc.), Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and other relevant software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Job Requirements:**

* Must be able to work evenings, on weekends, and before normal business hours (10:00am-6:30pm or 12-8:30 on SFP Program evenings) for events, outreach, and training.
* Must clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Commitment to complete all required annual training, including environmental prevention training.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.
* If the position becomes permanent, it will become subject to the SEIU Local 1021 Collective Bargaining Agreement, and the employee will be required to enroll in accordance with the applicable agreement.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* As a temporary position, this position is not eligible for Horizons’ health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits, except for benefits required by applicable law.
* **If the position becomes permanent, the employee will become eligible for Horizons’ benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance, effective on the first of the month following one full month of continuous employment, as well as paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and professional development opportunities, subject to applicable eligibility requirements.**
* Hourly wages range from $28.37 to $29.22.

Application Deadline: **Open Until Filled.**

new_jobs.title: Real Estate Transaction, Listing & Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
An established luxury residential real estate agent is seeking an experienced, proactive Real Estate Transaction, Listing & Marketing Coordinator to support a luxury residential real estate business in Menlo Park, Atherton, and surrounding Peninsula communities.

Full-time and part-time candidates are welcome. You will work directly with the agent, providing dedicated support across transactions, listings, marketing, and social media. The right person responds quickly, checks every detail, anticipates next steps, and follows through without reminders. You will own coordination from listing preparation through closing and execute consistent, polished marketing and social media.

Compensation: Up to $100,000 per year for full-time employment, depending on experience and qualifications, plus bonus. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed hours.

Location: Menlo Park, CA. Local in-person availability is required for property preparation, vendor appointments, and listing needs.

TRANSACTION COORDINATION

* Manage files from executed contract through closing, track deadlines, and follow up independently on outstanding items.

* Review paperwork for accurate names, dates, signatures, initials, and completeness before sending for review or signatures.

* Coordinate with clients, agents, escrow, title, inspectors, and lenders; flag issues early with proposed next steps.

* Maintain organized, complete transaction files and manage Side platform submissions and compliance follow-up under broker guidance.

* Must be approved to work as a transaction coordinator on Side's platform before taking over transaction files. Current Side approval and hands-on Side experience are strongly preferred.

LISTING COORDINATION

* Own listing preparation schedules and launch checklists.

* Coordinate staging, inspections, photography, video, contractors, cleaners, landscaping, signs, keys, and lockboxes.

* Prepare and organize disclosure packages and listing documents; coordinate accurate MLS entries and updates under agent direction.

* Meet vendors at properties and keep sellers and the agent informed of progress and next steps.

MARKETING AND SOCIAL MEDIA

* Create polished brochures, email campaigns, property website updates, and just-listed, open-house, and just-sold materials.

* Maintain a social media content calendar; draft captions, create branded posts and stories, edit simple reels, and schedule approved content.

* Turn the lead agent's market insights and listing content into consistent marketing, coordinating with photographers, videographers, and outside designers.

* Proofread every asset for accurate property information, spelling, links, branding, and required brokerage disclosures.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Proven California residential transaction coordination experience, with strong knowledge of contracts, disclosures, deadlines, and brokerage workflows.

* Active California real estate license required.

* Demonstrated listing coordination experience and ability to manage several properties and transactions at once.

* Excellent responsiveness, attention to detail, written communication, judgment, and follow-through.

* Comfortable with MLS, electronic signatures, disclosure tools, Google Workspace, Canva, and social media scheduling tools.

* Ability to show examples of polished real estate marketing and social media work.

* Peninsula market experience and experience supporting a busy luxury real estate agent are preferred.

* Able to travel locally to properties throughout the service area.

TO APPLY

Submit your resume, preferred full-time or part-time schedule, and a brief note describing your transaction coordination experience, current Side approval status, and listing and marketing responsibilities. Include examples or links to social media or marketing work you created. Finalists may be asked to complete a practical work sample and provide professional references.

We value ownership, accuracy, discretion, clear communication, and a positive, solutions-focused approach.

Pay: Up to $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**JOB TITLE:** HBCI Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** HBCI Program Supervisor

**DEPARTMENT**: HBCI (Home Based Crisis Intervention Program)

**JOB TYPE:** Part Time, 21 hours per week

**OBJECTIVES:** Reporting to the HBCI Program Supervisor, the part-time HBCI Coordinator supports the delivery of high-quality, family-centered, home-based crisis intervention services for youth and families by providing clinical supervision, staff support, program oversight, and regulatory compliance monitoring. The HBCI Program Coordinator collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery, adherence to OMH and agency standards, and the achievement of program goals and outcomes while promoting best practices in behavioral health care.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Works closely with the HBCI Program Supervisor to ensure all HBCI program requirements are met.

* Collaborate with the HBCI Program Supervisor in the development and implementation of program goals, objectives, and strategies.

* Supervises Interventionists who provide on-site and crisis-based intervention services to high-risk youth and their families.

* Accompany HBCI staff on initial home visits and provide coverage for visits when staff are unavailable or out of the office.

* Monitors the productivity and performance of HBCI Interventionists to ensure delivery of high-quality services.

* Reviews staff documentation in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to ensure timely, accurate, and complete recordkeeping.

* Ensures compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, including those established by OMH and DOHMH.

* Provides 24-hour on-call coverage for the HBCI program, as assigned.

* Collaborates with the Director of Behavioral Health/Clinic, Assistant Directors, Program Coordinators, Intake Department, and Quality Assurance team to deliver best-practice clinical services in compliance with OMH regulations.

* Attends agency, community, and external meetings and events as required.

* Performs other duties as assigned by the HBCI Program Supervisor and/or the Director of Behavioral Health.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS**:

* Knowledge and experience utilizing evidence-based treatment models and interventions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships.
* Ability to present program services and information to community organizations and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated cultural competence, humility, and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* LMSW/ LCSW or LMHC with a current New York State License.
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with children, adolescents, or young adults experiencing acute mental health crises.
* Experience providing services to youth and families impacted by behavioral health challenges.
* Experience delivering home-based services and willingness to travel to clients’ homes.
* Experience providing clinical supervision to staff, SIFI training preferred.
* Bilingual Spanish-speaking skills preferred.

**COMPENSATION: $35 per hour, 21 hours per week**

**About Northside**

Northside Center for Child Development serves more than 5,500 children and families across New York City each year through high-quality, outcome-driven behavioral health, early childhood education, and enrichment services. With over $34 million in annual funding, Northside provides the comprehensive support children and families need to overcome adversity, build resilience, and pursue their dreams.

Founded in 1946 in Harlem, Northside has been a cornerstone of the community for eight decades, leading the way in integrating education and mental health to support children’s development. Several of Northside’s innovative programs were the first of their kind in Harlem, setting standards of care that continue to influence social service agencies throughout the United States today.

Northside’s founders, Drs. Kenneth B. and Mamie Phipps Clark, were renowned, pioneering psychologists whose groundbreaking research was instrumental in the 1954 Brown v. Board of Education landmark Supreme Court decision that declared school segregation unconstitutional. Their belief in the worth, dignity, and potential of every child continues to guide Northside’s mission and inspire its work today. Northside is driven by its vision and principle, “Each Child…First Chance.”

For more information on Northside Center for Child Development, please visit www.northsidecenter.org.

new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in New York City, NY)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data

Identify local marketing opportunities that increase awareness, attract new guests, encourage repeat visits, and grow sales.

Coordinate restaurant-specific promotions, offers, product launches, and marketing campaigns in accordance with brand standards and franchise requirements.

Develop partnerships with schools and community organizations through approved fundraising nights, spirit nights, donation programs, and other community engagement initiatives.

Coordinate requests for charitable contributions, food donations, sponsorships, and in-kind support in accordance with established budgets and approval procedures.

Represent the restaurant professionally at community meetings, networking events, business association gatherings, and local functions.

Create opportunities for the restaurant to support local causes, celebrate community achievements, and demonstrate its commitment to being a responsible community partner.

Maintain an organized calendar of community events, sponsorship commitments, fundraising activities, and outreach opportunities.

Track community partnerships and engagement activities to evaluate their impact on brand reputation, guest loyalty, and restaurant business.

3. Digital Marketing and Local Brand Presence

Support the execution of local digital marketing initiatives through approved social media channels, email communications, local listings, and other marketing platforms.

Translate national marketing campaigns into effective local execution while maintaining consistency with brand standards.

Coordinate with franchise ownership, restaurant management, and designated brand representatives regarding marketing calendars, promotional materials, and campaign requirements.

Ensure local marketing activities comply with franchise agreements, brand guidelines, approved messaging, and applicable legal

The Production Control team is responsible for a wide range of activities that are crucial to the manufacturing process including execution of the monthly production plan, coordinating the implementation of engineering changes, maintaining accurate inventory and government property, monitoring the health of the ERP and WMS systems and developing/implementing material flow strategies/processes to support efficient movement of material.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing and coordinating all aspects of production. Here you will work on cutting-edge technology aimed at advancing the state-of-the-possible. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with MRP/ERP/MES (Netsuite, Oracle or equivalent systems)
* Strong computer skills, familiar with the full suite of MS Office products

* Must be able to lift and move items of 20 pounds or more on a regular basis and repetitively lift weights on raised surfaces
* Must be able to climb, bend, kneel, crawl, and stoop on a frequent basis and for extended periods
* Willing to work overtime and weekends as needed
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in organizing files and documents
* Inventory experience

As an Associate in the Restaurant Success team, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and nurturing relationships with restaurants within the SMB organization. Your primary responsibility will be managing an assigned book of business, with a focus on retention and engagement. You will serve as the key contact for restaurants, working to resolve issues, improve satisfaction, and drive long-term partnerships.

**The Impact You Will Make**

* Prevent merchant attrition through communicating with merchants who want to cancel by solving their underlying issues and handling objections to keep them live on the platform.
* Management of paused accounts in your book of business - quickly resolving their issues and getting them back live for order taking.
* Updating contracts, processing changes of ownership, and providing support with legal issues, such as fraud.
* Help merchants attract new diners, increase orders, and improve service quality by providing merchants with marketing support and educating them on Grubhub's products, including upselling marketing rates and utilizing perks/promotions.
* Resolve inquiries quickly to develop trust and ultimately win loyalty with restaurant owners.
* Resolve complex payment and tax inquiries and coordinate with the appropriate teams.
* Ensure account integrity and accuracy by updating account information.
* You will effectively manage SLAs to meet turnaround time expectations while providing a great merchant experience.
* In addition to managing your book of business, you will also be responsible for a round-robin queue. Your responsibilities here include resolving partner issues, answering questions, and updating account information as needed.
